lastRequest: Build a fullstack Flashcard Hub with Express, Prisma database models, Express endpoints, and a React frontend. The application must store decks and cards in the database, allow creating and editing cards via REST APIs, display them on a clean Vercel-style card deck dashboard, and feature mock test quizzes with strict TypeScript safety.

tasks.title: Data Modeling and Prisma Schema Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma ORM configuration, define User, Deck, Card, and QuizSession models with strict relations, and run initial migrations.

tasks.title: Backend Express API Implementation
tasks.description: Build robust Express REST API controllers and routes with Prisma client integration and Zod validation for decks, cards, and quiz sessions.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Layout and Deck Dashboard
tasks.description: Create the main application layout, navigation, and Vercel-style dashboard displaying deck metrics, grids, and fetch hooks.

tasks.title: Flashcard Editor and Creator Interface
tasks.description: Implement modal-based card and deck creation/editing forms utilizing react-hook-form, Zod validation, and TypeScript safety.

tasks.title: Interactive Quiz Mode and Analytics
tasks.description: Build an immersive flashcard study mode with Framer Motion animations, scoring logic, analytics summary, and canvas-confetti.
